app.name: SLA Review
app.description: Review provider terms against Dynatrace evidence and service ownership

scopes.name: environment-api:credentials:read
scopes.comment: Read an administrator-selected AppEngine credential for an optional provider incident connection

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Read problem events that can affect SLA posture

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: Read the Grail buckets behind the Davis Problems view

scopes.name: openpipeline:bizevents:ingest
scopes.comment: Queue an operator-approved FinOps review for a completed evidence package

scopes.name: storage:bizevents:read
scopes.comment: Show FinOps routing outcomes in SLA Review

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: Read service health signals for SLA evaluation

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: Check whether correlated log telemetry exists

scopes.name: storage:spans:read
scopes.comment: Check whether distributed tracing telemetry exists

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: Read provider inventory and service-to-runtime topology for provider discovery and SLA matching

scopes.name: slo:slos:read
scopes.comment: Check the native objective inventory for overlaps before proposing a product scope SLO

scopes.name: slo:slos:write
scopes.comment: Create one explicitly confirmed customer screening objective for a verified provider product, account, and region

scopes.name: automation:workflows:read
scopes.comment: Show the SLA Review routing and feedback Workflows in Automate

scopes.name: automation:workflows:write
scopes.comment: Create private undeployed routing and feedback Workflow drafts after an explicit operator action

scopes.name: app-settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: Read custom terms, provider connections, confirmed SLA matches, and evidence decisions

scopes.name: app-settings:objects:write
scopes.comment: Manage custom terms, SLA matches, provider connections, and human evidence decisions
